sentences.text: Enquiries arrive from Facebook ads, your website, WhatsApp and phone calls, and each one needs a quick, personal follow-up.
Miss one, and the deal goes to someone else.
ProgBiz ERP brings your leads, follow-ups, WhatsApp chats and team performance into one simple platform.
Sales executives know who to call next, managers see the whole pipeline live, and business owners see which marketing and which people deliver results.
Here is how your team uses it, every day.
The day starts on the Home screen.
New leads, follow-ups, delayed work and completed activities are visible at a glance, with today’s schedule, recent follow-up history and a lead summary by stage.
Need an answer fast? Just ask the AI Assistant.
Type a question like, how many leads today, and get the answer from your own business data in seconds — no reports, no spreadsheets.
Ask about follow-ups due today, delayed tasks, project status, or who is present today.
Every conversation is saved, so you can pick up where you left off.
For managers, the CRM Dashboard turns sales activity into a clear picture.
Win rate, conversion rate, lost rate and pipeline value sit right at the top, with every lead grouped by stage — new, cold, warm, hot, won and lost.
Leads in follow-up are split into today’s, delayed and upcoming, so priorities are obvious.
Scroll down to compare every executive side by side, follow call activity, and see which lead sources actually bring in revenue.
All your enquiries live in Leads.
Tabs keep new, in follow-up, won and lost leads apart, and Status View shows every stage of your sales process.
Powerful filters find any lead by source, quality, assignee, date, or even Facebook campaign.
And when priorities change, Lead Transfer moves leads between executives in bulk.
A lead is only as valuable as its next action.
Follow-ups are sorted into today’s, delayed, upcoming and non follow-up, so nothing slips through the cracks.
Prefer a board? Kanban View shows every follow-up by status, with the next date, last contact and executive on each card.
Your customers are already on WhatsApp, and so is ProgBiz.
The shared inbox brings every WhatsApp chat into the CRM, so your whole team works from one place, with search and unread filters, and no conversation is lost.
A chatbot greets every new enquiry with your own welcome message and helps customers find the right service, day and night.
Add your documents and product details to the Knowledge Base, and the chatbot AI answers customer questions for you.
Need to reach many customers at once? Send a broadcast.
Pick an approved WhatsApp template, choose your customers, and send it immediately, or schedule it for later.
Then track every campaign — sent, delivered, read, clicked and replied — along with the enquiries and wins it brought in.
AI Call Analysis reviews your team’s recorded calls.
Every call gets a lead score, an agent score and the customer’s sentiment, and managers can listen to any recording right from the list.
Open a call to read an AI summary and a coaching note, so you know which calls went well, and how to close the next one.
Lead Expenses keeps track of what you spend on every lead source and ad.
Together with your results, it shows the real cost per lead and the return on your marketing.
Executive Performance brings it all together.
Each executive gets one score, built from target achievement, win rate, won value and activity, so your best performers rise to the top and everyone can see where to improve.
For business owners, that means fewer missed leads, faster replies on WhatsApp, a sales team that is easy to coach, and marketing money spent where it works.
ProgBiz ERP — bringing your business workflow together.
